David W. Crain.fact: During his tenure, he patented the technology that later evolved into the "1st and Ten" system commonly called the football "yellow first-down line". Crain was awarded US Patent 4084184 "TV Object Locator and Image Identifier" on April 11, 1978.

David W. Crain.question: In 1999, he co-founded the _____ for Strategic Planning and served as its president
David W. Crain.fact: In 1999, he co-founded the Association for Strategic Planning and served as its president. He was inducted into the Hall of Fame of the reincorporated International Association for Strategic Professionals in 2009.
